newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Trans-Asia unit to offer power plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Trans-Asia unit to offer power plant deal.

text.p: Trans-Asia Power Generation Corp of the Philippines is in the final stages of negotiations over a turnkey contract to build a 1.2 billion peso power plant, its parent firm said on Wednesday.

Trans-Asia Oil and Mineral Development Corp said in a statement its new power unit was holding talks with a foreign firm on the supply of equipment, local civil works, installation and commissioning of a 50 to 53 megawatt plant.
The plant will supply electricity to Hi Cement Corp, which is trebling its production capacity in a 5.8 billion peso programme, the statement said.
Trans-Asia and its unit, along with Hi Cement, are all part of a group called the Philippine Investment Management Consultants Inc (Phinma).

The statement said the power plant was part of Trans-Asia Oil's diversification programme. The company is also investing in an industrial estate where the Phinma group is planning to set up an integrated steel mill.
Besides Hi Cement, the Phinma group also owns Davao Union Cement Corp and Bacnotan Cement Corp.
